jurisdictions.check: Prior consent, granular categories, withdrawal as easy as consent
"Do Not Sell or Share" link shown, GPC signal honoured
Reject visually equal to accept before Google tags fire
Third-party transfer disclosure names recipient and destination
Purpose notice before collection, local representative named
Notice content and published DPO contact

findings.title: Analytics and marketing cookies set before consent
findings.detail: _ga, _ga_R7X2, _fbp and __lt__cid are written on first paint, before the banner is shown. GTM, Meta Pixel and LINE Tag all load unguarded.

findings.title: GPC signal ignored
findings.detail: navigator.globalPrivacyControl is true on load and marketing tags still fire. No .well-known/gpc.json is served.

findings.title: No "Do Not Sell or Share" link
findings.detail: Footer carries a privacy policy link only. CCPA requires a clear and conspicuous opt-out link on the homepage.

findings.title: One cookie unclassified
findings.detail: ajs_anonymous_id is set by Segment but is absent from the cookie table in the privacy policy.

findings.title: Thai notice falls back to English
findings.detail: The th-TH language switcher resolves, but /privacy returns the English policy. Thailand requires the notice in a language the data subject understands.

findings.title: No local representative named for Thailand
findings.detail: PDPA s.37(5) requires an appointed representative in Thailand for foreign controllers offering goods to Thai data subjects.

findings.title: Cross-border transfer wording is generic
findings.detail: The policy says data "may be transferred outside your country". APPI requires naming the destination country, its regime, and the recipient's safeguards.

findings.title: DPDP itemised purposes not yet present
findings.detail: Marketing is offered as one category. India will require a per-purpose itemised notice with a withdrawal route. Substantive obligations land around May 2027.

findings.title: DPDP notice language menu
findings.detail: Notice is English-only. From ~May 2027 it must be offered in English plus any of the 22 Eighth Schedule languages on request.

passed: Reject All is present and visually equal to Accept All
Granular category choices offered, none pre-ticked
Closing the banner does not record consent
Preferences can be reopened from the footer
Privacy policy names the controller and a reachable contact
Data subject rights section is complete for GDPR
Singapore DPO contact published with an email address
Policy updated within the last 12 months
notVerifiable: Data protection impact assessment for the advertising stack
Processor contracts with Google, Meta and LINE
Consent records and their audit trail
DPO appointment filed with the Singapore PDPC
